# Pelford Clinics - appointment-reminder configuration

`appointment-reminder` sends SMS reminders for booked appointments across the Pelford clinics.

Two config layers apply: config/appointment-reminder.json is the production instance config and config/reminder-defaults.json is the platform defaults. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the defaults. A key in neither layer has no value at all.
